description: NaMg₆BO₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.23 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and four longer (2.14 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.68 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.27 Å. B is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (1.52 Å) and four longer (2.14 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₂Mg₂B₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to five Mg and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent B atoms to form ONa₂Mg₂B₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂B₂ octahedra and edges with eight ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂B₂ octahedra and edges with eight ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent B atoms to form ONa₂Mg₂B₂ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with eight ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 1.93 Å.
